intents.text: Add broker config `cordoned.log.dirs` (list, default empty, low importance), settable statically and dynamically per broker via Admin/kafka-configs.sh, validated so entries are in log.dirs/log.dir or `*` (all), with removal uncordoning.
Gate the feature on metadata version 4.3-IV0: below it, dynamic setting is rejected with a configuration error and a static setting has no effect.
Brokers report their cordoned directories to the controller in broker heartbeats once caught up with metadata, so dynamic changes apply without restart.
Topic and partition creation without explicit assignments uses only brokers with at least one uncordoned directory, failing with INVALID_REPLICATION_FACTOR if too few remain.
Explicit assignments onto a broker with no uncordoned directory fail with INVALID_REPLICA_ASSIGNMENT.
Partition reassignments onto a broker with no uncordoned directory fail with INELIGIBLE_REPLICA.
AlterReplicaLogDirs moving a replica onto a cordoned directory fails with INVALID_REPLICA_ASSIGNMENT.
The broker never selects a cordoned directory for a new replica, regardless of the directory the controller suggested.
DescribeLogDirs reports cordoned state per directory: LogDirDescription gets an isCordoned() accessor and the log dirs tool prints it.
Add an integration test on an embedded cluster that cordons/uncordons via Admin and checks partition placement and returned errors, plus unit tests for changed components.

constraints: Existing test suites must stay green
Feature requires metadata version 4.3-IV0 (already defined, not yet production)
